answer: In an economy where agents trade ferrous scrap, timber, and ember detectors, each agent’s voting power is proportional to tokens locked in escrow for 90 days, with no bonus per account. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand fake identities therefore gives the attacker exactly the same influence as one account. To gain more control, the attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, paying acquisition costs and losing their use for the lock period.
